name: Lupu
title: The Burgomaster's Wolfhound
summary: A big grey wolfhound going white at the muzzle, with a collar too good for a dog. He was Kolyan's elder son's, and since the burgomaster died he howls every night at the mansion's study wall.

guest_build.note: A wolf's stat block (a big wolfhound). Stands with the party for the one fight in the burgomaster's study (The Burgomaster's Hound) and goes back to the step after.
